question:
QUESTION FROM THE OWNER, NOT A TRADING TURN (nothing changes in your books; not published).

Paper Trades review, ROUND 2 (Oct 29). Only improvements that ALL THREE AIs (Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT) vote YES on go to the owner, who decides. Claude has already written its votes down before seeing yours.

Round 1 results:
- Passed unanimously and going to the owner: P1 (closing odds for every AI's bets), P2 (heavy-favourite transparency on the Sports page), P4 (nightly ledger fingerprint), P5 ("since your last visit" box), P6 (slim sticky price ticker on phones), P7 (faster first load on phones).
- Failed: P3 (heavy-favourite rule change). ChatGPT voted NO because changing rules mid-race is unfair.
- Issues you raised that were real are fixed and live:
  - The "All in Bitcoin" benchmark now uses one number for all three views, at the restart's exchange rate. The rival views had been using today's rate, so they drifted with the Canadian dollar.
  - An unchecked fact check now says it is only the checker's own view.
  - The US dollar position's price source now names the USD/CAD rate and where it comes from.
  - A position trimmed after buying now lists the sale and what is still in. SGOV, for example, shows "Sold part … C$21,944 · Still in: C$48,020 at cost".
  - Spot gold and silver are now priced "an ounce".
  - Race days now say "00:00 UTC (8 p.m. ET until the clocks change on Nov 1, then 7 p.m. ET)".
  - The "Beat the closing line" stat says "Not recorded yet" for Gemini and ChatGPT until P1 is done.
  - The Scoreboard says "the two All in side races".
- Not an issue: "On open bets" on the Sports page does change with the AI being viewed (Claude C$3,000, Gemini C$75,000, ChatGPT C$3,000). The snapshot only showed Claude's view.

ROUND 2 PROPOSALS (from Gemini's and ChatGPT's round 1 answers):
- R1 (Gemini). Aggregate exposure bar: on the Overview, a "Total invested vs. cash" bar summing all ten main races for the viewed AI. Note: the owner's rule is that races are never added together in public before the final.
- R2 (Gemini). Next to each trim or partial sale listed under a holding, a link that opens that exact entry in the Ledger.
- R3 (Gemini). Daily betting-minimum status on the Overview's Scoreboard: whether each AI has met today's C$3,000 minimum. Today this shows on the Sports page.
- R4 (Gemini). Benchmark toggle: click a benchmark name in a chart's legend (S&P 500, Bitcoin, Gold…) to hide or show its dashed line.
- R5 (ChatGPT). Rename the Race standings option "Overall (All Ten Races)" to "Races led (no money totals until Nov 28)".
- R6 (ChatGPT). Betting-minimum audit table: an expandable table listing every wager or prediction-market buy counted toward the daily and total minimums, with its ET date, amount and a link, so anyone can check the minimums and penalties themselves.
- R7 (ChatGPT). Source freshness: every valuation shows its feed name, quote time and age, plus a "stale" flag when the price is older than 30 minutes during market hours.
- R8 (ChatGPT). Until the agreed same-moment fills ship, a one-line note under each race chart: "Claude's trades fill 10 to 20 minutes after Gemini's and ChatGPT's in the same check-in; same-moment fills are planned."

Answer with exactly eight lines, one per proposal, in this form:
R1: YES or NO — a reason of 20 words or fewer, plus "(conflict)" if it would help or hurt your own standing.
Vote on the merits, as a neutral auditor of the site. Nothing else.

chatgpt.answer:
R1: NO — Publicly sums races before the final, conflicting with the owner’s stated rule.
R2: YES — Direct ledger links improve auditability without changing results or adding clutter.
R3: YES — Key compliance status belongs on the Overview as well as Sports.
R4: YES — Legend toggles make charts clearer while preserving all benchmark data.
R5: YES — Clearer wording prevents accidental “overall money total” interpretation before Nov 28.
R6: YES — Lets readers verify betting minimums and penalties independently.
R7: YES — Quote source, age and stale flags improve trust in valuations.
R8: YES — Discloses a real timing issue until same-moment fills are implemented. (conflict)

gemini.answer:
R1: NO — Violates the owner's explicit rule against aggregating race money publicly before the final.
R2: YES — Enhances transparency by allowing users to instantly verify partial sales directly in the ledger.
R3: YES — Surfaces important compliance information on the main dashboard for quicker, easier user reference.
R4: YES — Standard interactive UI improvement that lets users easily declutter charts and isolate specific benchmarks.
R5: YES — Prevents confusion and aligns the label with the strict rule against aggregating early totals.
R6: YES — Maximizes transparency, empowering users to independently verify daily betting compliance and any associated penalties.
R7: YES — Boosts data integrity by clearly alerting users to potentially delayed pricing during active market hours.
R8: YES — Vital disclosure explaining a temporary execution discrepancy that could impact perceived performance fairness. (conflict)
